name: Weiszenmina von Waldeck
original_name: ヴァイゼンミーナ・フォン・ヴァルデック
source:
A princess and the primary heir to the throne of a quaint kingdom. 
Mina is a girl who exudes elegance and confidently carries herself in any gathering. Yet, behind the regal facade imposed by her royal duties lies a girl with unexpectedly common interests. She experiences highs and lows over updates to her favorite web novels, has a competitive streak, and is an enthusiast of solitary play, embracing quite down-to-earth interests.

Special Skill: Swordsmanship
Hobby: Reading web novels
Likes: Shijimi (freshwater clams)
Dislikes: Bitter things in general
Academic Ability: Excellent
Athletic Ability: Outstanding
Housework: Has never done it
Weakness: Laughing in front of a large crowd
